method: Native pinned MiniLM 384 dimensions, .3 threshold, title/claim first 500 chars, 256 tokens, short-query scale 11/12, limit eight, constant 36-hour claim age. Baseline and candidate share complete-claim evidence and packet-budget input; baseline retrieval unchanged. New cases frozen before candidate scoring. Final development replay precedes reserved replay. Reserved incidents were exposed in prior work.
inputs_sha256_encoding: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2) plus newline; ignores formatter whitespace only.

safety.guards: Every primary and required claim identity/hash, delivered-fact retention, primary delivered rank and every retrieved required rank; complete-answer retention; exact negative returned/rendered/full ID order; trust/repository/tag/caller filtering, no embedding fallback, eight-record and declared packet bounds.

limitations: Correlated extensions of eight exposed source incidents, two policies and repeated budget profiles are not independent validation.
Capacity cases require 15 facts with an eight-record ceiling; excluded from headline recall.

Negative pools sometimes contain 1–8 records and intentionally name known symbols. Freezing those pools is a regression guard, not a precision/abstention success claim; new title negative injection remains 100%.
Unrequested trailing claims may change within the existing focused scope; protected-context checks do not establish universal relevance.
No new paired live-agent task outcomes or latency benchmark. Existing release-quality gate remains unchanged and unsatisfied by this retrieval report.
